def test_pagination():
        run_id = os.environ.get("ZEALT_RUN_ID", "default-run-id")
    
        # 1. Insert 5 messages
        for i in range(1, 6):
            insert_args = json.dumps({
                "text": f"Message {i}",
                "runId": run_id
            })
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["npx", "convex", "run", "messages:insert", insert_args],
                cwd=PROJECT_DIR,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True
            )
